question: Should `HEARTBEAT.md` gain task-level model metadata, should heartbeat split or group due tasks by model through a broader routing contract, or should whole-turn plugin routing remain the supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but implementation depends on maintainer intent for public `HEARTBEAT.md` syntax, task batching versus split turns, and how model overrides compose with provider auth, fallbacks, and session state.

options.title: Design shared heartbeat routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat task routing contract before accepting `HEARTBEAT.md`-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only model field
options.body: Implement a narrow `HEARTBEAT.md` task `model` field with explicit split/group semantics, alias/fallback rules, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document whole-turn `before_model_resolve` plugins as the supported routing path and accept that multiple due heartbeat tasks cannot be independently routed today.

recommendation.title: Design shared heartbeat routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat task routing contract before accepting `HEARTBEAT.md`-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the model hook seam, task-batching commit path, and product-boundary decision needed here.
